description:
Mesh-block polygons within 1 km of the property (GeoJSON), each with
avg annual growth, investor counts, modal street and median sold price.

**Price: 30¢ per call.**

geojson.description: When false, geometry is dropped — every Feature keeps its per-mesh-block stats but its `geometry` is null. Use it for the stats surface without the polygons (default true — response unchanged).
